name: agent-loop
description: An agent graph that improves itself: /agent-loop:lead preflights the repo, plans a task in small units and runs test-writer, implementer, tester and independent reviewer agents, recording what each stage caught; /agent-loop:retro mines those records and your session transcripts for recurring mistakes, promotes fixes up a ladder (instruction, hook, test) behind a human gate, and checks that each rule actually worked.
